message_feedback_not_returning.issue: Message Pydantic model in /app/backend/models/schemas.py was missing feedback, feedback_at, feedback_by fields
message_feedback_not_returning.root_cause: ConfigDict(extra='ignore') was silently dropping fields not explicitly defined in the model
message_feedback_not_returning.fix: Added feedback: Optional[str], feedback_at: Optional[str], feedback_by: Optional[str] fields to Message model

critical_code_review_comments: Backend models extraction to schemas.py was incomplete - Message model was missing new feedback fields
The fix ensures feedback data flows through properly: POST saves to MongoDB, GET returns via Pydantic model
